features.name: Arcane Initiate

effects.note: You have studied the arcane and learned a broader understanding of it, so you gain proficiency with two tools of your choice and languages, plus Arcane Recovery, which lets you regain spell slots by spending hit dice at a short rest.

features.summary: Proficiency with two tools, two languages, and Arcane Recovery
features.text: You gain proficiency with two tools of your choice and with two languages of your choice.

features.name: Arcana Domain Spells

effects.note: You learn two abjuration wizard spells, always prepared and not counting against your prepared spells, with more at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

features.summary: Two abjuration spells, always prepared
features.text: You learn abjuration spells from the wizard list. These spells are always prepared and do not count against your number of prepared spells.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration

effects.note: As a magic action, you can spend channel divinity to grant a creature within 120 feet resistance to an acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage of your choice for 1 hour, and the creature ends the effect early or if it is incapacitated, and at 18th level the resistance is to all of them.

features.summary: Spend CD: 1 hour of one damage type's resistance
features.text: As a magic action, you can spend channel divinity to grant a creature resistance to an acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage for 1 hour.

features.name: Spell Breaker

effects.note: You can disrupt the weave of a spell. As a reaction, when you see a creature casting a spell or using a magical item, you can use your reaction to add 2 to the DC of that spell or item, forcing a creature to make a Constitution saving throw or expend any spell slots to complete the action, rolling a d20 and using the total if it equals or exceeds the spell's DC, and the effect lasts 1 minute, and at 18th level you can use this twice per long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: +2 to an enemy's spell DC, forcing extra cost
features.text: As a reaction, when you see a creature casting a spell or using a magical item, you can use your reaction to cause the spell or item to have an increased DC for that creature.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your spells run stronger than usual, so when you cast any spell with a healing or necrotic theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases at 17th level by 1d8, and at 11th level necrotic healing also heals you.

features.summary: Healing and necrotic spells deal extra 2d8 of their type
features.text: When you cast any spell with a healing or necrotic theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it.

features.name: Arcane Mastery

effects.note: You have learned to see the truth of things. As a bonus action, you can learn the name and level of the last spell you cast, and at 18th level you also learn its school of magic.

features.summary: Bonus action: learn the name of your last spell
features.text: As a bonus action, you can learn the name and level of the last spell you cast.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency

effects.note: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise, any of the following: heavy armor, medium armor, shields, or any simple weapon.

features.summary: Proficiency with a gaming set and two more areas
features.text: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: heavy armor, medium armor, shields, or any simple weapon.

features.name: Reaper

effects.note: You have learned to reap the souls of the dying, so as an action you can make a melee spell attack with a 60 foot range to cause 2d10 necrotic damage plus your Wisdom modifier, plus 1d10 for each cleric level above 1, and if the target dies, you regain hit points equal to 2d10 plus your cleric level, and at 17th level this becomes 4d10 and 4d10 healing.

features.summary: Once a day: necrotic damage; killing it heals you
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee spell attack with a range of 60 feet to cause 2d10 necrotic damage plus your Wisdom modifier, plus 1d10 for each cleric level above 1.

features.name: Death Domain Spells

effects.note: You learn two necromancy wizard spells, always prepared and not counting against your prepared spells, with more at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

features.summary: Two necromancy spells, always prepared
features.text: You learn necromancy spells from the wizard list.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death

effects.note: As a bonus action, you can channel divinity and make a melee spell attack with a range of 5 feet, and on a hit it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10 necrotic damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a failure or half on a success, and if it fails, it can't regain hit points, and at 17th level the damage increases to 18.

features.summary: Spend CD: 10 necrotic, which blocks healing
features.text: As a bonus action, you can channel divinity and make a melee spell attack with a range of 5 feet.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction

effects.note: You have learned to make death certain. You have disadvantage on saving throws against necrotic damage, and at 18th level your Reaper and Touch of Death additionally deal damage equal to 1d8 plus your cleric level to a creature that can't see you, and this damage is in addition to your damage.

features.summary: Disadvantage on saves against necrotic damage
features.text: You have disadvantage on saving throws against necrotic damage.

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: Your weapon strikes true, so as an action you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 necrotic damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis necrotic on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 necrotic damage.

features.name: Improved Reaper

effects.note: Your Reaper can be used twice without taking a short or long rest, and its damage and healing are 4d10 rather than 2d10, and you can use it as a bonus action.

features.summary: Reaper works twice per rest and as a bonus action
features.text: You can cast Reaper twice without taking a short or long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency

effects.note: You gain proficiency with smith's tools and one type of artisan's tools.

features.summary: Proficiency with smith's tools and an artisan's tool
features.text: You gain proficiency with smith's tools and one type of artisan's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge

effects.note: You have learned to imbue a weapon you are proficient with with a blessing, so as an action on a turn when you hit a creature with a melee attack with that weapon, you can imbue it with a blessing of your choice for 1 minute, and while the weapon is blessed you have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and at 17th level the blessing lasts 10 minutes instead.

features.summary: Bless a weapon for +1 attack and damage
features.text: As an action on a turn when you hit a creature with a melee attack using a weapon, you can imbue the weapon with a blessing of your choice for 1 minute.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing

effects.note: As a bonus action, you can channel divinity and choose a creature within 60 feet, and it gains a 10-sided die it can roll to add to one ability check or saving throw, and it can be used before or after the roll, and the die is gone after, and at 17th level it is 12d10 and the target can use it twice.

features.summary: Spend CD: hand out a d10 to add to one roll
features.text: As a bonus action, you can channel divinity and choose a creature within 60 feet of you.

features.name: Soul of the Forge

effects.note: You know your soul is linked to your forge, so the bonus damage from Divine Strike is 2d8 at 6th level and 3d8 at 11th, rather than 1d8, and you also gain resistance to radiant damage, and you are immune to being blinded.

features.summary: Divine Strike scales faster; radiant resistance and blind immunity
features.text: You have resistance to radiant damage, and you are immune to being blinded.

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 radiant damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis radiant on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire

effects.note: You embody the divine fire, so the bonus damage from Divine Strike increases to 4d8, you gain immunity to fire damage, and at 18th level you also gain immunity to being charmed.

features.summary: Divine Strike deals 4d8; immunity to fire
features.text: The bonus damage from your Divine Strike feature increases to 4d8.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency

effects.note: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: any type of gaming set and medium armor.

features.summary: Proficiency with a gaming set and medium armor
features.text: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: any type of gaming set and medium armor.

features.name: Circle of Mortality

effects.note: You have mastered the circle of life and death, so you gain proficiency in Medicine and Religion, and you can cast the aid and sanctuary spells as cleric cantrips cast with your spellcasting ability, and at 17th level you also gain prepare the dead, which lets you cast animate dead.

features.summary: Medicine and Religion proficiency; aid and sanctuary as cantrips
features.text: You gain proficiency in the Medicine and Religion skills. You learn the sanctuary cantrip.

features.name: Eyes of the Grave

effects.note: You can see death, so at will you can detect the presence of any creature within 30 feet that has 1 hit point or fewer, whether it's living, dead, dying or undead, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track undead.

features.summary: Sense creatures at 1 HP or fewer within 30 ft
features.text: At will, you can detect the presence of any creature within 30 feet of you that has 1 hit point or fewer.

features.name: Path to the Grave

effects.note: As an action, you can channel divinity and cause one creature within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw, and on a failure its speed is halved to a minimum of 1 and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn, and at 17th level the speed reduction can't go below 5.

features.summary: Spend CD: halve a creature's speed and hinder it
features.text: As an action, you can channel divinity and cause one creature within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door

effects.note: As an action, you can touch one creature within 10 feet of you that is at 0 hit points and is your ally, and it becomes stable, and at 6th level you can instead use this on yourself and regain 1d8 plus your cleric level, and at 18th level it is 2d8.

features.summary: Action: stabilise a dying ally
features.text: As an action, you can touch one creature that is within 10 feet of you and that has 0 hit points.

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 necrotic damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis necrotic on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 necrotic damage.

features.name: Keeper of Souls

effects.note: You can feel death's advance, so the bonus damage from Divine Strike increases to 6d8 at 6th level and 8d8 at 16th, and when you reduce a creature other than an undead to 0 hit points with this feature, you have advantage on saving throws against the living dead for the next minute, and at 18th level your Reaper kills restore your full hit points.

features.summary: Divine Strike deals 6d8 then 8d8 necrotic
features.text: The bonus damage from your Divine Strike feature increases to 6d8 at 6th level and 8d8 at 16th level.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge

tools: any two of Calligrapher's supplies or Scribing supplies

effects.note: You have studied a breadth of knowledge, so you gain proficiency in two tools of your choice, either Calligrapher's supplies or Scribing supplies, and you gain two languages of your choice, and you can replace any wizard spell you prepared for a ritual spell of the same level.

features.summary: Two scribe tools, two languages, and ritual spells
features.text: You gain proficiency with two tools of your choice, either Calligrapher's supplies or Scribing supplies.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages

effects.note: As an action, you can channel divinity to grant a creature within 60 feet temporary proficiency in a language you know and the ability to read any script you can see for 1 hour, and at 17th level the target can also translate mundane speech.

features.summary: Spend CD: 1 hour of language and script comprehension
features.text: As an action, you can channel divinity to grant a creature proficiency in any language you know.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts

effects.note: As an action, you can channel divinity to read the thoughts of any creature within 30 feet of you that is within your line of sight, and on a failed Wisdom save the creature is spell-affected, unable to hide its thoughts from you and disadvantage on Charisma checks against you for 1 minute.

features.summary: Spend CD: read a creature's thoughts
features.text: As an action, you can channel divinity and target one creature within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your knowledge empowers your magic, so when you cast a spell that deals psychic or thunder damage, it deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level.

features.summary: Psychic and thunder spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with a psychic or thunder theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type.

features.name: Visions of the Past

effects.note: You have peered too deeply into knowledge, so as an action you can take total and precise control of one object within 30 feet that is unattended and not being worn or carried, and until the end of your next turn the GM has disadvantage on any check to perceive the object's true nature, and at 18th level the property is permanent until you cast it again.

features.summary: Action: mask an object's true nature from perception
features.text: As an action, you can take total and precise control of one object within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency

effects.note: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: any type of heavy armor and the Medicine skill.

features.summary: Proficiency with a gaming set, heavy armor and Medicine
features.text: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: any type of heavy armor and the Medicine skill.

features.name: Disciple of Life

effects.note: You show mercy and promote vitality, so you know the cure wounds cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot, and you also learn a domain spell of the Life domain at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th and 18th level, and you can cast the bless and cure wounds spells as cantrips.

features.summary: Cure wounds at will; bless and cure wounds as cantrips
features.text: You learn the cure wounds cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life

effects.note: As an action, you can channel divinity and distribute healing to a number of creatures within 30 feet of you, and the total healing divides among them, and if you choose a creature at 0 hit points it is stabilized, and at 17th level the healing increases to 25.

features.summary: Spend CD: distribute healing among creatures you choose
features.text: As an action, you can channel divinity and distribute healing among any number of creatures within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Blessed Healer

effects.note: You have a vocation of tending the maimed, so as a reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet regains hit points from any source but itself, you can give that creature 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier in temporary hit points, and the target is immune to the frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

features.summary: Reaction: a healed ally gets 1d8 + Wis temp HP
features.text: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you regains hit points from any source but itself, you can use your reaction to give that creature 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier temporary hit points.

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 radiant damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis radiant on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Supreme Healing

effects.note: You have mastered the greatest healings, so once on your turn or when you end concentration on bless, you can regain 2d8 plus your cleric level in hit points, and the cleric level increases by 1 for each Cleric level after 17th, and at 18th level Disciple of Life also works on your allies.

features.summary: Free action: 2d8 + Cleric level healing, once a turn
features.text: Once on your turn, or when you end concentration on bless, you can regain 2d8 + your cleric level in hit points.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip

effects.note: You know the sacred flame cantrip, castable at will without a slot, and an extra light domain spell at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 18th level, and you can cast the burning hands and scorching rays spells as cantrips.

features.summary: Sacred flame at will; burning hands and scorching ray as cantrips
features.text: You know the sacred flame cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Warding Flare

effects.note: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to make the attacker take 1d4 radiant damage plus your Charisma modifier, which they must make a Dexterity save against, and at 6th level the damage is 1d8.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d4 + Cha radiant against your attacker
features.text: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to make the attacker take 1d4 radiant damage plus your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn

effects.note: As a magic action, you can channel divinity and present your holy symbol, and if you do, the creature of your choice within 30 feet that can see you makes a Constitution saving throw, and on a failure it is blinded and any attack it has disadvantage on until the end of your next turn, and at 18th level it is also deafened.

features.summary: Spend CD: daylight blinds a creature and sows its attacks
features.text: As a magic action, you can channel divinity and present your holy symbol.

features.name: Improved Flare

effects.note: Your Warding Flare burns brighter, so when you use it the attacker takes 1d8 radiant damage plus your Charisma modifier instead of 1d4, and at 18th level Warding Flare also blinds the creature if it can see you and fails a Constitution save.

features.summary: Warding Flare deals 1d8 instead of 1d4
features.text: Your Warding Flare feature deals 1d8 radiant damage plus your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your light burns hotter, so when you cast a spell with a radiant theme, it deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level, and at 18th level radiant healing also heals you.

features.summary: Radiant spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with a radiant theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Corona of Light

effects.note: As a bonus action, you can emanate a 40-foot radius sphere of bright light for 1 minute, and any creature that starts its turn in the light must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded until the start of its next turn, and at 18th level you can move 10 feet toward a creature of your choice within the light whenever you use this.

features.summary: Bonus action: a 40-ft light that blinds creatures in it
features.text: As a bonus action, you can emanate bright light in a 40-foot-radius sphere around yourself for 1 minute.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature

effects.note: You are a servant of nature, so you learn the druidcraft cantrip, castable at will without a slot, and learn a druid spell you can cast as a cleric cantrip, and can cast shillelagh, and you can learn two more druid spells at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 18th level.

features.summary: Druidcraft at will, and druid spells cast as cantrips
features.text: You learn the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Charm Animals and Plants

effects.note: You have learned to befriend creatures, so you gain proficiency in the Animal Handling, Nature and Survival skills, and you can charm a Beast or Plant within 30 feet of you with a Wisdom save, and it is charmed by you for 8 hours or until you or an ally kills it.

features.summary: Three skill proficiencies; charm a Beast or Plant for eight hours
features.text: You gain proficiency in the Animal Handling, Nature, and Survival skills.

features.name: Dampen Elements

effects.note: As a reaction when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, you can take no damage and gain temporary hit points equal to 2 plus your Wisdom modifier, and the trigger ends, and at 18th level this works twice per long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: negate one elemental hit and gain temp HP
features.text: As a reaction when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can take no damage.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your nature magic surges, so when you cast a spell with a healing or thunder theme, it deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level, and at 18th level thunder healing also heals you.

features.summary: Healing and thunder spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with a healing or thunder theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type.

features.name: Master of Nature

effects.note: As a bonus action, you can cast shillelagh without a material component and then charm a creature within 60 feet, and at 17th level you gain a second use of this feature, and when you use it you also gain the ability to move 10 feet.

features.summary: Bonus action: shillelagh and charm a creature
features.text: As a bonus action, you can cast shillelagh without a material component.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies

effects.note: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: any type of gaming set and heavy armor.

features.summary: Proficiency with a gaming set and heavy armor
features.text: You gain proficiency with two additional areas of expertise: any type of gaming set and heavy armor.

features.name: Voice of Authority

effects.note: Your voice carries authority, so as a bonus action you can speak a command to a creature within 30 feet of you, and if it hears you it must make a Wisdom save, and on a failure it moves to a place you choose within 30 feet and doesn't attack on its turn, and at 18th level its speed can't be reduced to 0 while affected.

features.summary: Bonus action: command a creature to move and stand down
features.text: As a bonus action, you can speak a command in a strong voice.

features.name: Order Domain Spells

effects.note: You learn two abjuration wizard spells, always prepared and not counting against your prepared spells, with more at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

features.summary: Two abjuration spells, always prepared
features.text: You learn abjuration spells from the wizard list.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand

effects.note: As an action, you can channel divinity and present your holy symbol, forcing a creature within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save, and on a failure it is frightened for 1 minute or until you tell it to stop, and it automatically fails saves against being charmed.

features.summary: Spend CD: frighten a creature for a minute
features.text: As an action, you can channel divinity and present your holy symbol.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law

effects.note: You know the laws of the land, so you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and you also have immunity to being charmed, and at 18th level you can use your Voice of Authority on a creature as a reaction rather than a bonus action.

features.summary: Immune to charmed; Voice of Authority as a reaction at 18
features.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed.

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 radiant damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis radiant on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Order's Wrath

effects.note: You exude an aura of lawful authority, so the bonus damage from Divine Strike increases to 6d8 at 6th level and 8d8 at 16th, and while you have this feature, if you make a melee attack against a creature and hit, you can use a reaction to force it to make a Strength save, and on a failure it is frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.summary: Divine Strike deals 6d8 then 8d8; hits can frighten
features.text: The bonus damage from your Divine Strike feature increases to 6d8 at 6th level and 8d8 at 16th level.

features.name: Implement of Peace

effects.note: You make peace through a shield or a simple weapon, so you can add your Charisma modifier to attack or damage rolls with a shield or simple weapon, and at 6th level you gain proficiency with shields and light armor.

features.summary: Charisma modifier adds to shield and simple weapon rolls
features.text: You can add your Charisma modifier to attack or damage rolls when you make an attack with a shield or a simple weapon.

features.name: Emboldening Bond

effects.note: You can strengthen your allies, so as an action you can forge a bond between up to three willing creatures within 30 feet of you, and each can add 1d4 to an attack roll or saving throw while it's within 60 feet of you or another bonded creature, and the bond ends at the end of your next turn if a creature goes to 0 hit points or 30 feet away from all bonded creatures, and at 6th level the bonus increases to 1d6 and you can use it twice per day.

features.summary: Action: up to three allies add 1d4 to rolls for a minute
features.text: As an action, you can forge a bond between up to 3 willing creatures within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Peace Domain Spells

effects.note: You learn two enchantment wizard spells, always prepared and not counting against your prepared spells, with more at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

features.summary: Two enchantment spells, always prepared
features.text: You learn enchantment spells from the wizard list.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace

effects.note: As an action, you can channel divinity and spread a soothing calm, and any creature within 30 feet of you makes a Constitution save, and on a failure it has advantage on all saving throws against magical or magical effects until the end of your next turn, and at 17th level the duration is 1 hour.

features.summary: Spend CD: allies gain advantage on magical saves
features.text: As an action, you can channel divinity and spread a soothing calm.

features.name: Protective Bond

effects.note: Your bond shields allies, so when a creature within 30 feet of you that is affected by your Emboldening Bond takes damage, you can use your reaction to take the damage instead, and you gain the use of this when you finish a long rest, and at 18th level it works twice per long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: take the damage meant for a bonded ally
features.text: When a creature within 30 feet of you that is affected by your Emboldening Bond takes damage, you can use your reaction to take the damage instead.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your magic soothes, so when you cast a spell with a healing or enchantment theme, it deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level, and at 18th level enchantment healing also heals you.

features.summary: Healing and enchantment spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with a healing or enchantment theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type.

features.name: Expansive Bond

effects.note: Your bond reaches further, so Emboldening Bond's bonus is 1d6 and you can forge it with up to six creatures, and creatures can add 1d6 to an attack roll or saving throw while within 60 feet of any other creature that you have bonded with, and you can use it twice per long rest, and at 18th level it can also add 1d6 to an ability check.

features.summary: Emboldening Bond: six allies, 1d6, longer reach
features.text: The bonus granted by Emboldening Bond increases to 1d6, and you can forge the bond between up to 6 willing creatures.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies

effects.note: You gain proficiency with any type of heavy armor, medium armor, shields and simple weapons.

features.summary: Heavy armor, shields and simple weapon proficiency
features.text: You gain proficiency with any type of heavy armor, medium armor, shields, and simple weapons.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm

effects.note: Your power flows from storms, so you have resistance to lightning damage, and at 6th level, when you cast a spell of 3rd level or higher that deals lightning damage, it deals an extra 1d8 lightning damage, and at 17th level you also have resistance to thunder damage.

features.summary: Lightning resistance; 3rd-level spells add 1d8 lightning
features.text: You have resistance to lightning damage.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath

effects.note: When you deal lightning damage to a creature from a spell of 3rd level or higher, you can use a bonus action to deal an additional 2d10 lightning damage to the target, which makes a Strength save, taking half as much on a success, and at 18th level the damage increases to 3d10.

features.summary: Spend CD: 2d10 extra lightning on a big spell
features.text: When you deal lightning damage to a creature from a spell of 3rd level or higher, you can use your bonus action to deal an additional 2d10 lightning damage.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal an additional 2d8 thunder damage to it, making a Strength save, and at 18th level you can instead push it 10 feet away and knock it prone.

features.summary: Reaction: 2d8 + Cha thunder on a melee hit
features.text: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal an additional 2d8 thunder damage.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your spells storm, so when you cast a spell with a lightning or thunder theme, it deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level.

features.summary: Lightning and thunder spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with a lightning or thunder theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type.

features.name: Stormborn

effects.note: You are the storm itself, so the bonus damage from Wrath of the Storm increases to 2d10 at 6th and 3d10 at 16th, your Destructive Wrath damage increases to 3d10, and you have resistance to thunder damage, and at 18th level you also have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

features.summary: Thunder resistance and bigger storm damage
features.text: The bonus damage from your Wrath of the Storm feature increases to 2d10 at 6th level and 3d10 at 16th level.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster

effects.note: You bless those who deceive, so you learn the charm person cantrip, castable at will without a slot, and you know one illusion domain spell, plus three more at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th and 18th level, and you can cast disguise self and silent image as cantrips.

features.summary: Charm person at will; disguise self and silent image as cantrips
features.text: You learn the charm person cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity

effects.note: You weave deception, so as an action you can magically create a sound within 120 feet, and choose a creature within range to hear it and the GM chooses whether the target believes it, and on a success it makes a Charisma (Deception) check against your spell save DC, and a failure leaves it marked and everything it says is untrue.

features.summary: Spend CD: an illusionary sound that marks a creature's lies
features.text: As an action, you can magically create a sound within range.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows

effects.note: You step between worlds, so as an action you can step up to 10 feet to a place you can see and become invisible, and the effect ends if you attack or cast a spell, and at 17th level you can use this twice per day, and invisible creatures still make noise when they move.

features.summary: Spend CD: vanish for an hour
features.text: As an action, you can become invisible.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your deceptions bite, so when you cast a spell with an illusion or psychic theme, it deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level, and at 18th level psychic healing also heals you.

features.summary: Illusion and psychic spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with an illusion or psychic theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type.

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 psychic damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis psychic on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 psychic damage.

features.name: Improved Duplicity

effects.note: Your deceptions are hard to see through, so a marked creature's Charisma checks to deceive you have disadvantage, and its first attack roll after you or another creature deceives it has disadvantage, and at 18th level, as a bonus action you can dim the light around yourself within 30 feet to create a dim area for 1 minute and hide in it.

features.summary: Marked creatures are disadvantaged against deception
features.text: A creature marked by your Invoke Duplicity has disadvantage on Charisma checks to deceive you.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies

effects.note: You gain proficiency with any type of heavy armor, medium armor, shields and simple weapons.

features.summary: Armor, shield and simple weapon proficiency
features.text: You gain proficiency with any type of heavy armor, medium armor, shields, and simple weapons.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 1

features.name: Eyes of Night

effects.note: You have learned to see in darkness, so you have darkvision out to 60 feet, and if a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on it, and at 17th level your Twilight Sanctuary also ends the frightened condition on creatures in it.

features.summary: Darkvision 60 ft; reaction to disadvantage adjacent attacks
features.text: You have darkvision out to 60 feet, and if a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 1

features.name: Vigilant Blessing

effects.note: You are ever watchful, so the blessed creature or your ally's Twilight Sanctuary also ends the frightened condition on creatures in it, and at 11th level creatures in the sanctuary also have disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than the caster, and at 17th level it also ends the charmed condition.

features.summary: Twilight Sanctuary also ends frightened
features.text: Your Twilight Sanctuary ends the frightened condition for creatures in it.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 1

features.name: Twilight Domain Spells

effects.note: You learn two necromancy wizard spells, always prepared and not counting against your prepared spells, with more at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

features.summary: Two necromancy spells, always prepared
features.text: You learn necromancy spells from the wizard list.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 1

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary

effects.note: You call forth dim twilight, so as an action you can create a 30-foot radius sphere of dim light within 60 feet of you, and creatures in it that can see you make a Charisma save, and on a failure they are frightened until the end of your next turn, and at 17th level you can use this twice per long rest.

features.summary: Spend CD: a 30-ft sphere that frightens creatures in it
features.text: As an action, you can create a 30-foot radius sphere of dim light within 60 feet of you.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 2

features.name: Steps of Night

effects.note: You move as the shadows do, so as a bonus action, you become invisible and gain resistance to all damage, and the effect lasts until you attack or cast a spell, or take damage, or at the end of your next turn, and at 18th level when you use it you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.

features.summary: Bonus action: 1 minute of shadow and resistance
features.text: As a bonus action, you become invisible and gain resistance to all damage.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 6

features.name: Divine Strike

effects.note: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack, and on a hit you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 necrotic damage plus your Wisdom modifier on a critical hit or half as much on a hit, and at 18th level it works with a bonus action too.

features.summary: After a melee hit: 4d8 + Wis necrotic on a critical
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, you can use your bonus action to channel divinity and deal an additional 4d8 necrotic damage.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 8

features.name: Twilight Shroud

effects.note: You are wrapped in twilight, so the bonus damage from Divine Strike increases to 6d8 at 6th level and 8d8 at 16th, your Twilight Sanctuary is unaffected by any light sources and creatures in it don't see you, and at 18th level you can end the frightened condition on creatures within 30 feet of you.

features.summary: Divine Strike deals 6d8 then 8d8 necrotic
features.text: The bonus damage from your Divine Strike feature increases to 6d8 at 6th level and 8d8 at 16th level.

source.reference: Vampire's Guide to Ravenloft Twilight Cleric 17

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies

effects.note: You gain proficiency with any type of heavy armor, medium armor, shields and simple weapons.

features.summary: Armor, shield and simple weapon proficiency
features.text: You gain proficiency with any type of heavy armor, medium armor, shields, and simple weapons.

features.name: War Priest

effects.note: Your god favors the swift and strong, so you have a +1 bonus to Strength and Constitution saving throws, and you learn the divine favor spell, which you can cast as a bonus action on yourself or an ally within 30 feet, giving them 1d4 temporary hit points, and at 17th level it deals 1d4 radiant damage instead.

features.summary: +1 Str and Con saves; divine favor as a bonus action
features.text: You have a +1 bonus to Strength and Constitution saving throws, and you learn the divine favor spell.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike

effects.note: You can lend a fraction of your might to another, so as an action, you can make a melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet of you, and on a hit you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack using that weapon against the same creature, and at 17th level you can use Guided Strike twice per long rest.

features.summary: Spend CD: a free extra melee attack
features.text: As an action, you can make a melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use a bonus action to make your number of attacks equal to your Wisdom modifier, and at 18th level a creature has disadvantage on its first attack roll against you after this is used, and it can use this twice per long rest.

features.summary: Spend CD on a hit: attacks equal to your Wis modifier
features.text: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use your bonus action to make your number of attacks equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.note: Your magic strikes as your weapon does, so when you cast a spell with a divine theme, it deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type when a creature is damaged by it, and the damage increases by 1d8 at 17th level, and at 18th level divine healing also heals you.

features.summary: Divine spells deal extra 2d8
features.text: When you cast any spell with a divine theme, the spell deals an extra 2d8 of that damage type.

features.name: Avatar of Battle

effects.note: You embody your god's might, so the bonus damage from Divine Strike increases to 5d8, your Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing also grants an additional +1 damage, and at 18th level if you end concentration on a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee spell attack.

features.summary: Divine Strike deals 5d8; an attack when concentration ends
features.text: The bonus damage from your Divine Strike feature increases to 5d8.
